arxiv-2105-04463.title: Eclipsing Systems with Pulsating Components (Types β \beta Cep, δ \delta Sct, γ \gamma Dor or Red Giant) in the Era of High-Accuracy Space Data
arxiv-2105-04463.creator: Patricia Lampens
arxiv-2105-04463.description: Abstract Eclipsing systems are essential objects for understanding the properties of stars and stellar systems. Eclipsing systems with pulsating components are furthermore advantageous because they provide accurate constraints on the component properties, as well as a complementary method for pulsation mode determination, crucial for precise asteroseismology.

arxiv-2201-06794.title: Resistance Training using Prior Bias: toward Unbiased Scene Graph Generation
arxiv-2201-06794.creator: Chao Chen, Yibing Zhan, Baosheng Yu, Liu Liu, Yong Luo, Bo Du
arxiv-2201-06794.description: Abstract S cene G raph G eneration (SGG) aims to build a structured representation of a scene using objects and pairwise relationships, which benefits downstream tasks. However, current SGG methods usually suffer from sub-optimal scene graph generation because of the long-tailed distribution of training data.

arxiv-2210-10603.title: New insights on the quantum-classical division in light of Collapse Models
arxiv-2210-10603.creator: Fernanda Torres, Sujoy K. Modak, Alfredo Aranda
arxiv-2210-10603.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Fernanda Torres, Sujoy K. Modak, Alfredo Aranda. We argue, in light of Collapse Model interpretation of quantum theory, that the fundamental division between the quantum and classical behaviors might be analogous to the division of thermodynamic phases. A specific relationship between the collapse parameter ( λ ) (\lambda) and the collapse length scale ( r C r_{C} ) plays the role of the coexistence curve in usual thermodynamic phase diagrams.

arxiv-2307-12576.title: Self-refining of Pseudo Labels for Music Source Separation with Noisy Labeled Data
arxiv-2307-12576.description: Abstract Music source separation (MSS) faces challenges due to the limited availability of correctly-labeled individual instrument tracks. With the push to acquire larger datasets to improve MSS performance, the inevitability of encountering mislabeled individual instrument tracks becomes a significant challenge to address. This paper introduces an automated technique for refining the labels in a partially mislabeled dataset.

arxiv-2309-05981.title: Learning Unbiased News Article Representations: A Knowledge-Infused Approach* Thanks: *This paper is partly supported by NSF: Research Experience for Teachers (RET); Award Number:2055557
arxiv-2309-05981.creator: Sadia Kamal, Jimmy Hartford, Jeremy Willis, Arunkumar Bagavathi
arxiv-2309-05981.description: Abstract Quantification of the political leaning of online news articles can aid in understanding the dynamics of political ideology in social groups and measures to mitigating them. However, predicting the accurate political leaning of a news article with machine learning models is a challenging task.

arxiv-2411-07590.title: Multiple Non-cooperative Targets Encirclement by Relative Distance based Positioning and Neural Anti-Synchronization Control
arxiv-2411-07590.creator: Fen Liu, Shenghai Yuan, Wei Meng, Rong Su, Senior Member, IEEE, Lihua Xie, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2411-07590.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Fen Liu, Shenghai Yuan, Wei Meng, Rong Su, Senior Member, IEEE, Lihua Xie, Fellow, IEEE. From prehistoric encirclement for hunting to GPS orbiting the earth for positioning, target encirclement has numerous real world applications. However, encircling multiple non-cooperative targets in GPS-denied environments remains challenging. In this work, multiple targets encirclement by using a minimum of two tasking agents, is considered where the relative distance measurements between the agents and the targets can be obtained by using onboard sensors.

arxiv-2504-11972.title: LLM-as-a-Judge: Reassessing the Performance of LLMs in Extractive QA
arxiv-2504-11972.creator: Xanh Ho, Jiahao Huang, Florian Boudin, Akiko Aizawa
arxiv-2504-11972.description: Abstract Extractive reading comprehension question answering (QA) datasets are typically evaluated using Exact Match (EM) and F1-score, but these metrics often fail to fully capture model performance. With the success of large language models (LLMs), they have been employed in various tasks, including serving as judges (LLM-as-a-judge).

arxiv-2506-05931.title: The Interplay of Polar and Nematic Order in Active Matter: Implications for Non-Equilibrium Physics and Biology Journal: J. Phys. A: Math. Gen.
arxiv-2506-05931.creator: Varun Venkatesh, Niels de Graaf Sousa
arxiv-2506-05931.description: Abstract Active matter has played a pivotal role in advancing our understanding of non-equilibrium systems, leading to a fundamental shift in the study of biophysical phenomena. The foundation of active matter research is built on assumptions regarding the symmetry of microscopic constituents. While these assumptions have been validated extensively, instances of mixed or joint symmetries are prevalent in biological systems.

pmc-10540262.creator: Zhenzhen Li, Jianbang Wang, Itamar Willner
pmc-10540262.description: Emulating native transient transcription machineries modulating temporal gene expression by synthetic circuits is a major challenge in the area of systems chemistry. pmc-13406714.description: Highlights What are the main findings?
